FN-YSKJN6N-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 134
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 134 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Department of Insurance until
October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 134
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 06/10/2024
Senate Bill 134 (Act 2024-233) as enacted provides for the continuance of the Department of
Insurance until October 1, 2028 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this act
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
